I have farmed this land for many years, and rice does well here when I give it proper attention. I will apply some NPK and urea because the soil needs help, and I also have poultry manure from my brother's farm to mix in. I plan to use the improved FARO seed I got from the extension agent last season, and I will spray herbicide to control the weeds that always trouble this plot. The rains should be enough for this lowland area, so I will not irrigate, but I will need to hire some young men to help with the heavy land preparation and harvesting work.
